format: WSDC Registry Events (post-event availability of results)

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Results (rounds, placements and score reports) must be posted at the event and stay open to competitors for at least thirty days; inaccurate results must be corrected by posting corrected results.

requirement: Published results and their score evidence must not be removable while a posting duty may still apply. This change only keeps the evidence (results, publications, ballots) from being hard-deleted with the event. Posting for at least 30 days, withdrawal and correction handling are OD-22 and OD-23 and are NOT implemented here.
enforcement_point: Database BEFORE DELETE trigger on public.events; not applied to any hosted database yet.

tests.name: OD-04 migration list, preflight list and SQL suite list name exactly the same tables

interpretation_notes: Partial coverage only: the 30-day posting duty itself (visibility, withdrawal vs posting, score reports, anonymous judge labels) is open under OD-22/OD-23. The 30 days is a minimum posting duration and is not a DanceFlow deletion trigger; nothing deletes after 30 days.
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
